name: Survey relief
description: The surveyed globe as a map-maker shades it: cover and bare ground in survey colours, every slope hill-shaded from the elevation layer under a light from the upper left, with a light graticule.

knobs.name: relief
knobs.label: Relief
knobs.meaning: How strongly the land's shape shows: slope exaggeration and shading together.

knobs.name: detail
knobs.label: Detail
knobs.meaning: How finely the GPU globe is built (mesh cells per face edge). Costs more as it rises.
